compare.heading: 99acres, MagicBricks, NoBroker, or an office in Chikoowadi
compare.intro: The portals are where most searches start, and they are good at one thing: showing you everything. Here is what changes when the person on the other end has walked the building.
compare.row1: Someone who has been inside the building before you visit it
compare.row2: Owner and title checked before the first viewing, not after the token
compare.row3: Society's no objection lined up before a price is agreed
compare.row4: Registered agreement and registration handled in person, end to end
compare.row5: Early access to new launches from developers we deal with directly
compare.row6: Nothing to pay until your deal actually completes
compare.row7: An office in Borivali West you can visit, since 2005
compare.footnote: Portals list what owners and brokers upload, and charge for visibility. NoBroker connects you to owners directly, and charges for its plans and services up front. Both are useful for seeing what exists. Neither has stood in the flat.
